content.value: . Draw a 2D sketch of the following governors mentioning unique features of each one. (i) Watt, (ii) Porter, (iii) Proell, (iv) Hartnell, (v) Hartung, (vi) Pickering

<sub>7(b).</sub> A porter governor has arms 250 mm each and four rotating Ilyballs of mass 0.8 kg each. The sleeve movement is restricted to 20 mm either way from the height when the mean speed is 100 rpm. Calculate the central dead load and sensitivity of the governor neglecting friction when the Ilyball exerts a centrifugal force of 9.81 N. Also determine the effort and power for 3 percent speed change.
